errors.claim: East Timor drops, shrinking by 44.2 percent
errors.reason: Gross domestic savings as a percentage of GDP can be negative, but describing it as 'shrinking by 44.2 percent' misinterprets the metric as a growth rate or change over time rather than a share of GDP.
